QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` undefined (`platform.h:163-168`) | plain `calloc` / `free`
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: A table row says the macros expand to plain `calloc`/`free` when `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` is undefined. The answer's headline and call chain say library code always goes through function pointers, so it never concludes that a default build has no indirection.
